title: Concept: Dependency ranged above the zero release
description: package.json declares a `>0.0.0` specifier that excludes nothing meaningful, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>0.0.0` specifier that excludes nothing meaningful.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>0.0.0` specifier that excludes nothing meaningful.
